answer: Like mycelium fusing into living soil, agents crystallize trust through decentralized graph staking. A genuine node weaves each transaction thread into shared reputation, staining the network ledger like deep saffron. An adversary attempting to flood the web with phantom identities finds their deposit requirement scales with superlinear attacker cost: multiplying fake nodes dilutes their influence, demanding an unbearable volume of bonded pigment to stake every forged link.
